name: feature.orgs.nodes
description: Org invitations node pack (ADR 0622 D2) — invite someone into THIS workspace (or a named org in it) over the ctx.features.orgs surface, list its pending/declined invitations, revoke one. Every node is gated on the run's acting user holding host:members:manage in the target org — the same predicate the /orgs/:orgId/invites routes use; a system run (schedule, webhook, host-event-started) fails closed. Delivery brokers the ACTING USER's email connection and needs OPENWOP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL for the accept link. Ids-only inputs and outputs — never the token. The onboarding step people-hr.onboarding's `invite-host` composes.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Orgs: Invite to Workspace
nodes.description: Mints an email-token invitation into the run's workspace root (or `orgId`) over ctx.features.orgs and delivers the accept link through the acting user's brokered email connection (send-once per inviteId). Requires an ACTIVE acting user holding host:members:manage in that org and OPENWOP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL on the host. An undeliverable invite is rolled back and fails TYPED (never success over an unreachable row); a prior live invite for the same (org, email) is superseded only after the new one is delivered. Side-effecting: a replay/fork is served the recorded outcome — a re-executed mint would be a NEW inviteId that kills the previously emailed link. Emits host.orgs.invitation.created stamped with the run's origin (workflow + chain lineage) so a binding on that event cannot re-trigger the executing chain or a sibling instance. `email` from inputs.email, else the frozen config.email ({{params.newHireEmail}}).

nodes.label: Orgs: List Invitations
nodes.description: Reads the invitations of the run's workspace root (or `orgId`): inviteId, role, status (pending/declined — ADR 0564), expiresAt. Never the recipient email, never the token. Requires an active acting user holding host:members:manage in that org.

nodes.label: Orgs: Revoke Invitation
nodes.description: Deletes one invitation (row, then its token-hash index) in the run's workspace root (or `orgId`) — the emailed link stops resolving. Requires an active acting user holding host:members:manage. A missing/foreign invite is a uniform typed not_found. Does not emit host.orgs.invitation.revoked (that event is the admin route's — one site, ADR 0622 D1).
